## Problem and resulting behavior

State the problem, the resulting behavior, and the affected specification requirements.

Refs: TODO item(s), requirement ID(s), and any resolved GAPS question(s).

## Verification

Record exact commands, outcomes, evidence paths, and material limitations.

- [ ] Changes satisfy the assigned specification and acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; new behavior has appropriate tests or a documented verification method.
- [ ] Quality reviewed correctness, maintainability, security, accessibility and relevant performance risks independently of the author.
- [ ] Validate assessed the integrated result against each in-scope acceptance criterion and recorded pass/fail/blocked evidence separately from quality review.
- [ ] The external peer provider reviewed both quality and specification criteria for the other provider's contribution at the integrated revision; actual CLI/model evidence, packet hash and reports support the result. Mixed authorship has reciprocal coverage. Missing prerequisites remain blocked, and preview/execution status alone is not acceptance.
- [ ] Aircraft behavior, data and avionics changes identify source, revision, applicability, rights and fidelity limits.
- [ ] Shared interfaces and both coding streams have been integrated and checked together.
- [ ] Security and dependency impacts are recorded; no secrets or unlicensed data are included.
- [ ] Documentation, TODO status and a timestamped DONE entry describe the completed change.
- [ ] Deviations and unresolved blockers are explicit; no blocked criterion is reported as a pass.
